_comment: Per-theme manual choices. Paths are sanitised keys relative to the theme folder (no extension), as listed in that theme's images.json. Keys: symbolDir, regular (ordered low->high, max 8), wild, scatter, background, frame (null = draw a plain reel frame), title, ui{...}, anims{symbolKey:{sheet|frames}}, lobbyIcon (Unity path relative to HolidaySlotAsset). uiLabeled: ui keys whose art already contains its text/icon (the app then draws no label).
